title: General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer
description:
General Insurance Claims and Administration Officer  



Remote | Philippines-Based | Monday to Friday, 9:00 am - 5:00 pm AEST



**To Apply** 



The General Insurance Claims & Administration Officer will provide claims and administrative support to a well-established general insurance broking firm in the Australian market. The role is primarily claims-focused: working under the direction of the Claims Consultant, you will help progress general insurance claims accurately and promptly through claims lodgements, insurer follow-ups, documentation requests, and record maintenance. 



Alongside claims, the role provides policy-servicing and general administrative support to the broking team to keep the brokerage running smoothly day to day. 





KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



** Claims Support **  



Claims Lodgements 

- Gather and collate the required information, then lodge new general insurance claims accurately and promptly through insurer portals and systems, in accordance with the Claims Consultant’s instructions 

- Accurately record client issues, claim details, and relevant updates in the appropriate systems and CRM 



Insurer and Claims Follow-Up 

- Contact insurers, claims teams, and assessors to obtain updates on outstanding claims, including making follow-up calls and remaining on hold as required to confirm claim status, outstanding requirements, and next steps 

- Follow up when responses, reports, assessments, or decisions are overdue 

- Monitor insurer commitments and follow up agreed actions within the required timeframes 

- Escalate delays, issues, or concerns promptly to the Claims Consultant 



Documentation and Information Requests 

- Request required claim documentation, including causation reports, damage photos, dates of loss or event, quotes, scopes of work, invoices, receipts, proof of ownership, repair or replacement information, and any other documentation required by the insurer 

- Send follow-up correspondence to clients or relevant parties only as instructed by the Claims Consultant, and report progress on outstanding documentation 

- File and record all information received accurately in the appropriate claim file and system 



Claims Administration 

- Monitor open claims and maintain accurate, current claim records 

- Diary and action follow-ups to keep claims progressing 

- Review insurer correspondence, identify outstanding actions, and prepare relevant information for the Claims Consultant 

- Maintain organised claim files and save all correspondence and supporting documentation correctly 

- Complete general claims administration and other tasks as directed by the Claims Consultant 





** Policy Servicing and Administrative Support **

 

- Manage and service an existing portfolio of clients across Builders Warranty and Construction policies, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Prepare quotes, policy documentation, renewals, endorsements, amendments, and cancellations 

- Assist brokers with assessing client needs and sourcing, negotiating, and placing suitable insurance policies with insurers 

- Maintain and update client databases, policy records, and CRM documentation accurately and promptly 

- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the broking team, including data entry, filing, and document management 

- Handle and liaise with insurers on behalf of clients on policy and servicing matters 

- Manage client enquiries professionally and efficiently through the firm’s approved communication channels 

- Build and maintain professional working relationships with clients and insurers, within the role’s defined authority 

- Identify and refer appropriate upsell or cross-sell opportunities to the broking team 

- Follow industry regulations, internal procedures, and documentation standards 

- Support the team with ad-hoc administrative tasks and projects as required 





SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 



You Must Have 

- 3 - 4 years of administrative or office support experience in general insurance, working for an Australian-based insurance broker 

- Hands-on experience in general insurance claims lodgement and claims management (not life, health, or superannuation) 

- Familiarity with general insurance terminology and insurer portals. 

- Well organised and highly motivated, with strong time-management skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple clients, and meet deadlines 

- Ability to work well under pressure in a fast-paced environment 

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach 

- Confident negotiation and problem-solving abilities 

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy 

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint 

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team 



Nice to have

- Experience using Insight or Office Tech broking systems 

- Experience managing or servicing Builders Warranty and Construction policy portfolios, including changes, amendments, cancellations, and occupancy permit submissions 

- Understanding of insurance products, policy wordings, and risk assessment 

- Proficiency with insurance broking systems 

- Tier 1 RG146 qualification 





**To Apply**

title: Expert Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Sourcer — Full-Time, Premium Pay
description:
Company: AckeeArkadia



Compensation: $10–$12 USD/hour, based on demonstrated experience



Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week, Flexible schedule



Location: Remote



Payment Method: PayPal ONLY

About the Opportunity



AckeeArkadia is seeking an exceptional, experienced Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage (OA) sourcing specialist for a U.S.-based e-commerce operation.



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for a proven sourcer who consistently discovers profitable, purchase-ready inventory opportunities with minimal supervision.



We offer premium compensation for premium talent and are interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with a professional who delivers measurable results.



Our sourcing philosophy prioritizes low-risk, high-confidence opportunities that generate sustainable profits without exposing our Amazon seller account to unnecessary risks.

Primary Responsibilities



    Consistently deliver a minimum target of 3 fully actionable, purchase-ready product leads per working day.



    Independently source profitable inventory from legitimate U.S. retailers and trustworthy suppliers.



    Use ArbiSource, Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, and advanced manual sourcing techniques to discover and validate opportunities.



    Verify product identity, sales demand, profit margins, competition, pricing stability, supplier legitimacy, and selling eligibility.



    Proactively identify retail arbitrage (RA) BOLO opportunities, clearance events, major discounts, and profitable bulk-purchasing opportunities.



    Monitor multiple product categories, including toys, collectibles, household products, accessories, and other profitable categories.



    Document sourcing results with accurate calculations and verifiable supporting evidence.



    Exercise independent judgment and reject products that present unacceptable business, authenticity, compliance, or account-health risks.



Minimum Product Requirements



All actionable leads must meet the following standards:



    ROI: Minimum 30%.



    Net Profit: Minimum $3 per unit after applicable expenses and Amazon fees.



    Sales Demand: At least 30 estimated monthly sales, supported by reliable product-specific evidence.



    Competition: Generally no more than 15–20 competing FBA sellers.



    Product Identity: Exact ASIN, UPC, model, size, color, variation, and pack-configuration match.



    Pricing: Stable selling prices supported by historical Keepa data.



    Inventory: Confirmed availability from a trustworthy supplier.



    Eligibility: Verified Amazon selling approval without unresolved restrictions.



    Account Safety: No unacceptable authenticity, intellectual-property, compliance, or account-health concerns.



Variation-specific demand verification is essential. Parent-level product sales estimates alone are not sufficient.



Incomplete, speculative, or inadequately researched products do not count toward the daily lead target.



Promising BOLO and speculative opportunities should be reported separately and are encouraged, but do not replace purchase-ready leads.

Required Experience and Skills



Advanced, hands-on experience with all three sourcing tools is mandatory.



ArbiSource



    Advanced sourcing, filtering, and opportunity identification.



    Independent verification of automated sourcing results.



    Identifying profitable opportunities beyond basic ROI calculations.



Keepa



    Advanced interpretation of pricing, sales rank, Buy Box, and competition history.



    Evaluating sales velocity and price sustainability.



    Understanding variation-specific sales performance.



    Recognizing misleading demand and temporary profitability.



SellerAmp SAS



    Accurate profitability and Amazon fee calculations.



    Product identification and competition analysis.



    Evaluating restrictions and relevant product risk indicators.



Additional Requirements



    Proven professional Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage sourcing experience.



    Strong understanding of Amazon selling restrictions and compliance.



    Extensive experience sourcing from U.S. retailers.



    Proven ability to independently identify profitable products.



    Strong documentation and research skills.



    Excellent communication and professional reliability.



    Ability to work independently with minimal instruction.



Onboarding and Performance Expectations



The selected candidate will receive one paid working day to familiarize themselves with our account, purchasing requirements, sourcing processes, and expectations.



Applicants must already possess the necessary sourcing expertise. Beginner sourcing training will not be provided.



After orientation, the normal performance expectation is a minimum of three fully actionable product leads per working day.



We recognize that legitimate sourcing opportunities can fluctuate. An occasional day without qualifying leads is understandable when accompanied by clear documentation of sourcing activity, opportunities examined, and reasons for rejection.



However, repeated zero-lead days, particularly multiple occurrences within the same working week, are unacceptable.



Performance is evaluated on the accuracy, quality, consistency, and actual purchase viability of submitted opportunities.



This is a performance-driven engagement. Continued work is contingent on meeting our standards, and significant or repeated performance deficiencies may result in termination of the engagement within the same week, consistent with applicable agreement terms.

Compensation and Payment Requirements



    Hourly Pay: $10–$12 USD, based on experience.



    Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week.



    Payment Method: PayPal ONLY.



    Potential performance-based incentives.



    Opportunity for an ongoing professional relationship with a growing U.S. e-commerce business.



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



All compensation is paid exclusively through PayPal.



We currently do not have access to alternative payment platforms and cannot accommodate payments through Wise, Payoneer, direct bank transfers, or other services.



The advertised hourly rate represents gross compensation before any applicable PayPal transaction, receiving, or currency-conversion fees.



The contractor is responsible for any PayPal fees deducted from their payments, subject to applicable law. These fees will not be reimbursed by the company.



Applicants must have an active PayPal account capable of receiving payments and must be comfortable with these payment arrangements.



If you cannot accept payment through PayPal under these conditions, please do not apply. This requirement is non-negotiable.

How to Apply



Please provide the following information:



1. Professional Experience



How many years have you worked as an Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage sourcer? Briefly describe your prior sourcing responsibilities.



2. Software Expertise



Describe your experience using ArbiSource, Keepa, and SellerAmp SAS. How do you typically incorporate all three tools into your sourcing process?



3. Proven Performance



How many genuinely purchase-ready leads did you consistently deliver per day in your most recent sourcing position?



4. Sourcing Examples



Provide two anonymized examples of profitable products you personally sourced, including purchase price, ROI, net profit, estimated monthly sales, and your verification process.



Do not disclose confidential employer information.



5. Risk Assessment



Describe an apparently profitable product you rejected and explain the specific warning signs that influenced your decision.



Important: Applications that fail to demonstrate substantial hands-on sourcing experience or omit the requested information may be disqualified.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to a brief interview. No sourcing assessment or access to our business accounts is required during recruitment.

Final Note



We are seeking an exceptional, independent sourcing professional who is ready to deliver results from the beginning.



We are not looking for someone who merely generates long lists of potentially profitable products. We are looking for a specialist who consistently identifies genuine purchasing opportunities supported by thorough research.



We value expertise, independent thinking, reliability, and measurable results.



If you have the experience, discipline, and proven track record to consistently discover profitable Amazon FBA opportunities, we encourage you to apply.

title: SENIOR RECRUITER – TALENT ACQUISITION STRATEGY & ANALYTICS
description:
SENIOR RECRUITER – TALENT ACQUISITION STRATEGY & ANALYTICS

Schedule: Full night shift aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours



ABOUT THE ROLE



Starbond is looking for an experienced Senior Recruiter to lead end-to-end recruitment and develop effective hiring strategies to support our growth.



We need someone who combines strong recruiting skills with strategic thinking, data analysis, and sound judgment. Beyond sourcing and interviewing, you will assess hiring challenges, analyze recruitment performance, identify bottlenecks, and recommend practical improvements.



You must have at least 10 years of total recruitment experience, including at least 4 years recruiting for U.S.-based roles, with demonstrated experience filling on-site positions.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications will be reviewed through
 only. We will not screen applications or resumes submitted through OnlineJobs.ph.



Please
 
 with the subject line: Senior Recruiter Application – [Your Name]



Include your updated resume and a link to a 3–5 minute Loom video introduction.



In your video, discuss the U.S.-based roles you have recruited for, particularly on-site positions, including industries and seniority levels. Explain your direct responsibilities throughout the recruitment process.



Share one challenging U.S. hiring search, the strategy you used, and the outcome. Also provide an example of how you used recruitment data to identify a problem or improve hiring results.



Ensure your Loom video link is accessible without requesting permission. Both your resume and Loom video are required for your application to be considered.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Recruitment Strategy and Hiring Partnership



Partner with hiring managers to clarify business needs, role requirements, priorities, and hiring timelines. Create clear job descriptions, candidate profiles, screening criteria, and interview plans.



Develop sourcing strategies based on each role’s complexity, location, compensation, and available talent pool. Identify hiring challenges early, including compensation gaps, limited candidate availability, and restrictive requirements.



Recommend changes to sourcing channels, candidate profiles, job positioning, or selection processes based on results and market feedback. Help hiring managers distinguish essential qualifications from skills that can be developed after hiring.



End-to-End Recruitment



Manage sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate evaluation, reference checks, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff. Recruit for U.S.-based, on-site roles and other positions across the organization.



Source through job boards, LinkedIn, Boolean search, referrals, direct outreach, and talent networks. Build candidate pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.



Conduct structured interviews and submit clear candidate assessments supported by specific examples. Maintain timely candidate communication and proactively follow up on feedback and hiring decisions.



Recruitment Analytics and Reporting



Maintain accurate recruitment records and dashboards. Analyze the recruitment funnel, from applications reviewed and candidates contacted through interviews, qualified endorsements, offers, and hires.



Track time to first qualified endorsement, stage conversion rates, time to fill, sourcing effectiveness, offer acceptance, and candidate withdrawals. Investigate where candidates drop out or fail to progress.



Identify whether hiring challenges stem from sourcing, candidate qualifications, role attractiveness, or internal decision-making. Present reports explaining what the data shows, possible causes, and recommended actions.



Measure whether strategy changes improve candidate quality, conversion rates, or hiring speed.



Process Improvement and Candidate Experience



Improve recruitment workflows for efficiency, consistency, and candidate experience. Develop screening tools, interview guides, evaluation scorecards, communication templates, and recruitment SOPs.



Use candidate and hiring manager feedback to improve the hiring process. Apply recruiting tools, automation, and AI while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment.



Support structured onboarding and a smooth transition from candidate to new hire.



Additional HR Support



Assist with offer letters, contracts, onboarding documents, and other HR records. Maintain accurate and confidential candidate and employee information.



Support employee engagement, performance review coordination, training activities, and other HR initiatives as needed. Maintain recruitment as your primary focus while balancing assigned HR support responsibilities.



QUALIFICATIONS



At least 10 years of total recruitment experience, including at least 4 years recruiting for U.S.-based roles. Demonstrated success filling U.S.-based, on-site positions is required.



Proven ability to manage recruitment independently and advise hiring managers on hiring strategies and challenges.



Experience analyzing recruitment data, interpreting funnel performance, and turning findings into actionable recommendations.



Strong Boolean search, LinkedIn sourcing, direct outreach, and referral development skills.



Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, PivotTables, charts, and recruitment reporting.



Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills, with the ability to provide clear, evidence-based recommendations.



Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to prioritize multiple searches based on business urgency and role complexity.



Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, recruitment platforms, and relevant hiring practices.



High standards of professionalism, confidentiality, accuracy, and integrity.



Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.



Availability to work a full night shift aligned with U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Hiring managers receive qualified candidates aligned with clearly defined requirements. Recruitment challenges are identified early and supported by practical recommendations.



Reports provide useful insights and next steps beyond activity counts. Hiring decisions progress through proactive follow-up and clear communication.



Recruitment strategies improve based on measured results.

title: AI Video Editor
description:
AI Ads Video Editor (Part-Time, Remote)



Do you get excited about crafting AI-powered ads that stop the scroll, hook viewers in the first 3 seconds, and drive real results, all without a founder in front of the camera? Do you want your edits running on paid traffic that reaches millions of people?

Growthzilla is a performance marketing agency. We run paid ads and funnels for clients in coaching, education, finance and professional services, and we are growing. Every ad we ship has one job: convert. We are looking for a creative who thinks the same way and wants to grow with us for the long haul.



The role

We are hiring an AI Ads Video Editor to produce high-performing paid ads built around AI avatars, AI voiceovers and creative formats that do not need a founder to film. You will work across several client accounts, each with its own offer, audience and brand voice, so you need to switch styles fast without losing the direct-response fundamentals.

This starts as a part-time role, roughly 15 to 25 hours a week. Workload is growing, and the plan is to move the right person to full time within the first months. If you want a long-term seat on a team that is scaling, this is it.



What you'll do

• Create AI-driven paid ads from concept to final cut: AI avatars, AI voiceovers, AI b-roll and motion graphics

• Produce ads in the style each client already runs. You will study their ad library and competitors and match or beat it

• Cut attention-grabbing hooks that keep viewers watching until the CTA

• Work in volume and quality: ads that launch at scale and perform, across several accounts at once

• Turn high-quality copy from our copywriters and strategists into high-quality ads

• Use performance data and winning ads to improve the next round of creatives

• Stay on top of the latest AI tools (HeyGen, Synthesia, ElevenLabs, Runway, Sora, Kling, Midjourney and whatever comes next) and bring new formats to the team

• Bonus: brainstorm ad angles, scripts and concepts that maximize ROAS



Tools you should master

• AI video editing: Higgsfield, HeyGen, Synthesia, Captions AI or equivalent

• AI voice: ElevenLabs or equivalent

• AI video and image generation: Nano Banana, Runway, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, etc.

• Premiere Pro, CapCut or DaVinci Resolve (highly proficient in at least one)

• After Effects for advanced motion graphics



Who this role is not for

• You have never edited paid ads or do not understand direct-response creative

• You are not deeply familiar with AI editing tools and AI avatars

• You cannot commit to deadlines and hold them

• You go quiet when something slips instead of flagging it early and managing expectations



Who this role is for

• You are obsessed with AI tools and constantly testing what is new

• You understand what makes a paid ad convert, not just look pretty

• You have a strong grasp of paid ad structure: hooks, pacing, captions, CTAs and direct-response storytelling

• You want creative ownership while collaborating with a high-performance team

title: Supply Chain & Operations Specialist
description:

Incomplete applications or those that fail to follow instructions will not be considered.





E-COMMERCE OPERATIONS ASSISTANT

MORALVE | JOB DESCRIPTION

Department: E-commerce Operations | Reports To: Operations & Supply Chain Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time | Work Arrangement: Remote



POSITION OVERVIEW

MORALVE is seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, resourceful, and proactive E-commerce Operations Assistant to support the daily operations of our growing e-commerce business.



This versatile, hands-on role covers marketplace and account health monitoring, inventory tracking, customer service, logistics coordination, data entry, administrative support, and ongoing system and database maintenance.



The primary purpose is to ensure daily operations run smoothly, information remains accurate and current, and recurring tasks are monitored, documented, and completed. The assistant works closely with the Operations & Supply Chain Manager across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.



We value reliability, initiative, follow-through, adaptability, and willingness to learn as much as previous technical experience. As familiarity develops, the role can progress from task execution toward independent ownership of routine workflows, exception identification, and project coordination.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Marketplace Account Monitoring & Maintenance

• Perform daily and recurring checks across Amazon and other assigned marketplaces.

• Monitor account health, notifications, alerts, warnings, and pending action items.



2. Inventory Monitoring & Maintenance

• Monitor inventory availability and stock health across marketplaces and inventory systems.

• Track replenishments, transfers, inbound activity, and receiving updates.

• Update inventory trackers and compare internal data against marketplace records.



3. Customer Service & Customer Experience Support

• Monitor and respond to routine customer inquiries using established guidelines and templates.

• Support order inquiries, delivery concerns, returns, refunds, and replacements within approved authority.

• Track unresolved cases, document actions, and follow up to closure.

• Identify recurring product or service issues and escalate sensitive or nonstandard cases.



4. Logistics, Shipment & Order Monitoring

• Monitor shipment and logistics updates, communications, and operational notifications.

• Maintain shipment trackers and milestones, including estimated arrival, delivery, and receiving.

• Assist with Amazon FBA, AWD, and other marketplace inbound monitoring.

• Record shipment references and organize supporting documents.

• Follow up on missing routine updates and flag delays or discrepancies.



5. Purchase Order & Supplier Coordination Support

• Maintain purchase order records, production updates, and related tracking systems.

• Monitor supplier communications, completion dates, inspection updates, and outstanding information.

• Collect quotations, documents, and routine supplier information.



6. Data Entry, Database & Tracker Maintenance

• Perform accurate recurring data entry and maintenance in spreadsheets, trackers, and databases.

• Update records using verified
s, reports, marketplace information, and supplier communications.

• Identify duplicate, missing, outdated, or inconsistent data.

• Assist with historical backtracking, cleanup, cross-checking, and reconciliation.

• Follow established data standards, formatting, and naming conventions.



7.
, Communication & Task Management

• Monitor assigned operational inboxes and channels; categorize and label communications.

• Identify and execute routine actions, follow-ups, documentation, and escalation.

• Track outstanding requests and pending responses.

• Communicate updates to internal and external stakeholders as appropriate.



8. Document & File Organization

• Download, rename, categorize, and store operational files according to company standards.

• Organize product, shipment, purchase order, inspection, supplier, and customer service documents.

• Support historical file cleanup and ensure records are traceable to their transactions.



9. Routine Operational & Administrative Support

• Complete assigned daily, weekly, and monthly checklists and maintenance tasks.

• Assist with account checks, reporting, data collection, research, and administrative activities.

• Support routine coordination across departments and evolving business needs.



10. Project Coordination & Process Improvement

• Maintain assigned project boards, task lists, deadlines, and documentation.

• Track deliverables, follow up on action items, and report blockers early.

• Assist with small operational projects and SOP documentation.

• Suggest practical improvements to accuracy, organization, and efficiency.



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

• Experience in at least 3 areas: : e-commerce operations, virtual assistance, administrative support, customer service, marketplace management, inventory/order management, logistics support, or data entry.

• Working knowledge of Google Sheets and/or Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting, filtering, and organizing data.

• Strong attention to detail, organization, written and verbal English communication.

• Ability to interpret
s, spreadsheets, reports, and operational systems and determine routine next steps.

• Ability to manage recurring responsibilities, follow SOPs, and work independently in a remote environment.

• Reliability, accountability, problem-solving ability, and willingness to learn.



Preferred

• Experience with Amazon Seller Central or similar platforms.

• Familiarity with marketplace account health, listings, inventory, orders, and e-commerce customer service.

• Experience with Google Workspace and project tools such as 
, ClickUp, Asana, or Notion.

• Basic familiarity with Amazon FBA/AWD, shipments, purchase orders, and replenishment.

• Experience working with suppliers or logistics providers and maintaining SOPs or operational trackers.



KEY COMPETENCIES

Attention to Detail - Maintains accurate records and recognizes inconsistencies.

Reliability & Consistency - Completes recurring responsibilities on time.

Ownership & Accountability - Takes responsibility and follows tasks to completion.

Proactiveness - Identifies missing information, pending actions, and potential issues.

Problem-Solving - Investigates and proposes possible solutions before escalation.

Learning Agility - Learns new tools and processes quickly.

Organization & Prioritization - Distinguishes urgent issues from routine tasks.

Communication & Follow-Through - Provides timely updates and closes loops.

Adaptability - Supports changing needs across operational functions.

Process Discipline & Judgment - Follows SOPs and recognizes when approval is required.



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

• Complete daily, weekly, and monthly responsibilities accurately and on time.

• Keep operational records complete, consistent, and up to date.

• Identify and report marketplace, inventory, customer service, and logistics issues promptly.

• Track open inquiries and action items through resolution.

• Communicate progress, challenges, and blockers proactively.

• Gradually manage assigned recurring workflows with less supervision.



WORK SCHEDULE & BENEFITS

Work Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week

Work Arrangement: Remote

13th Month Pay: Provided annually

Paid Holidays: Paid Philippine Regular and Special Non-Working Holidays

Paid Time Off (PTO): 5 paid leave days per year

Team Environment: Collaborative and supportive remote team

Professional Growth: Hands-on exposure to e-commerce tools and operations



GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

Initially, the role focuses on learning MORALVE's systems, completing recurring tasks accurately, and maintaining reliable records. With demonstrated consistency, accountability, and judgment, the assistant may progress toward independent ownership of operational processes, advanced marketplace and inventory responsibilities, reporting and reconciliation, workflow improvement, and cross-functional project coordination.

title: Outreach & Partnerships Specialist (B2B Follow-Up + Creator Partnerships)
description:
About us

We're a small, founder-led e-commerce studio running two US-focused DTC brands:

A personalized book brand. Our newest product is a B2B gifting program: companies send their prospects a real, printed book written about that person, then follow up once it lands. It's the most memorable first touch a prospect will ever get.

A health tech brand making simple health smartwatches for adults 65+ and the families who look out for them.

Lean team, real ownership, fast decisions. You'll report to our marketing and operations lead and work directly with the founder.

The role

About 80% of your time covers three areas. The other 20% goes to whatever marketing work matters most that week: research, launch support, and testing new channels.

1. B2B follow-up (top priority)

We mail personalized books to targeted decision makers at US companies, mostly marketing, sales, and HR leaders.

Once a book is delivered, you call,
, and message the recipient on LinkedIn to turn their surprise into a booked demo.

You research prospects before reaching out and log every touch.

As you ramp up, you'll run some intro calls yourself.

If we test B2B for the smartwatch brand, you'll also reach out to organizations that serve older adults.

2. Creator partnerships

Find and vet creators on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube:

Parenting and family creators for the book brand

Aging, caregiving, and retirement creators (including "adult children of aging parents") for the smartwatch brand

Pitch collaborations, agree on deliverables, coordinate product seeding, keep content on schedule, and keep good relationships warm.

3.
 marketing

Help write, build, and send campaigns and simple automated flows (we use Klaviyo).

What success looks like

Every delivered book is followed up within a day.

Demos are booked every week.

A steady stream of creator content goes live.

The pipeline is clean enough that anyone can see where every lead stands.

We'll set specific targets together in your first month.

What you bring

2+ years in B2B outbound (SDR/BDR), partnerships, or influencer marketing

Real experience cold calling US businesses (outbound, not only inbound support)

Excellent spoken English: natural and confident with senior US professionals

Strong written English for
s, LinkedIn messages, and DMs

Persistence across multiple touches, and resilience with "no"

Experience vetting creators, including spotting fake followers and weak engagement

Discipline with a CRM or tracker (we use Airtable)

Comfort with priorities that shift week to week

Bonus points

Apollo, Klaviyo, or similar tools

Experience selling to marketing, sales, or HR leaders

Familiarity with corporate gifting or direct mail outreach

Details

Long-term contract, about 40 hours per week

Remote

You must work US Pacific business hours, because calls happen when US prospects are at their desks. That means a fixed shift of 12 am to 8 am Manila time.

ABOUT TÀBERG FALLS



Tàberg Falls Private Villas is a luxury resort of glass villas for couples, located on a river with a waterfall in Taberg, New York, at the gateway to the Adirondacks.



We opened in summer 2026, book direct with our guests, and have grown our Instagram audience to approximately 28,000 followers.

THE CREATIVE DIRECTION



Tàberg Falls is visually beautiful, but we do not want our social media to feel like a catalog of property photos.



We want to increasingly show real couples genuinely experiencing Tàberg Falls in a way that feels romantic, natural, believable, and human.



We want content that helps people imagine what it would feel like to stay here with someone they love.



Beautiful photography and editing matter, but the finished content should not feel artificial, overly produced, or AI-generated.



Real people, real moments, and real experiences should be at the center of the brand.



Authenticity is one of the core principles of the marketing we are building. We want people to trust what they see and feel that the experience we are showing is real.



We are looking for someone who can bring their own creativity and point of view to that direction while protecting the authenticity and trust we want the brand to communicate.





WHO WE’RE MARKETING TO



Our primary audience is established couples ages 30–60, primarily from greater NYC, Connecticut, Northern New Jersey, Buffalo, Rochester, Syracuse, Utica, and surrounding markets.



They are often busy professionals or business owners looking to disconnect from demanding lives and reconnect with each other.



Our goal is qualified audience growth that leads to direct bookings. Our broader marketing objective is to help drive Tàberg Falls toward 80%+ occupancy while maintaining or improving ADR.

 & WEBSITE SKILLS

title: Editorial / Educational DOCX Template Designer
description:
I am looking for an experienced editorial / educational document designer to create the universal lesson-packet design system for AnyText, an AI-assisted platform for adult ESL teachers.



PROJECT:

$300 fixed-price project. Some flexibility for an exceptional candidate with highly relevant experience.



AnyText takes an authentic article or transcript, adapts it to an adult ESL proficiency level, generates coordinated instructional activities, and exports the finished lesson as an editable Microsoft Word DOCX.



This is NOT simply a beautification project.



I need a professional, reusable document-design system that can eventually be implemented programmatically by my developer.



The template must work with VARIABLE CONTENT.



For example:

- A reading may be 1, 2, or 3+ pages

- Titles and questions may vary in length

- Activities may be included or omitted

- Sections may contain different numbers of items

- Images may be present or absent

- Teachers may edit the DOCX after export



The design therefore must reflow gracefully. I am not looking for one beautiful static mockup that only works with one sample lesson.



My developer will handle the DOCX programming. You will design the visual system and provide clear specifications he can implement.



DESIGN DIRECTION:



Adult-accessible editorial design.



Professional, scholarly, warm, calm, readable, restrained, and appropriate for adult learners.



Visual inspiration includes:

- The forest-moon atmosphere of Endor from Star Wars

- University libraries and reading rooms

- Independent bookstores

- Forest-facing study spaces

- The warmth and craftsmanship of older Starbucks interiors

- Oxford University Press

- Cambridge University Press

- The New York Times

- The Economist

- National Geographic



These are inspiration references only. I do not want literal Star Wars imagery, trees, fake wood, coffee-shop graphics, or a fake newspaper design.



The established AnyText palette is:



Deep Forest Green — #183F36

Dark Green-Black — #1F2B27

Charcoal — #303633

Mushroom Taupe — #A79D90

Warm Stone — #D8D1C6

Parchment — #F2EDE3

Paper White — #FCFBF8

Bronze / Umber — #8B6B50



I am NOT looking for a new color palette.



The final document must also remain professional when printed or photocopied in black and white.



SECTIONS TO DESIGN INCLUDE:



- Article title and metadata

- Images

- Contextual Introduction

- Key Concepts

- Warm-Up

- Main Reading

- Vocabulary Matching

- Vocabulary Fill-in-the-Blank

- Multiple Choice

- True / False

- Short Answer

- Discussion

- Pair Work

- Mingle

- Answer Key

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering



Each activity should belong to one unified visual system while still supporting its instructional purpose.



For example:

- Reading should feel like a professionally published educational reader

- Short Answer needs appropriate writing space

- Discussion should feel spacious and reflective

- Pair Work should make roles immediately understandable

- Mingle should support printable cut-apart strips/cards

- Answer Key should be compact and easy for teachers to scan



The final specification should define:



- Exact fonts

- Font sizes and weights

- Heading hierarchy

- Reading-body typography

- Directions and question styles

- Metadata treatment

- Line and paragraph spacing

- Margins

- Tables

- Borders

- Answer spaces

- Image placement and sizing

- Headers / footers

- Page numbering

- Page-break behavior

- Color usage

- Black-and-white behavior

- Rules for variable-length content



EDITABLE DOCX IS IMPORTANT:



Teachers will be able to rewrite questions, add notes, delete material, and otherwise edit the exported Word document.



The design therefore needs a strong underlying style system rather than fragile manual formatting.



ORIGINAL HUMAN DESIGN WORK REQUIRED:



I already use AI extensively to create educational resources and to develop AnyText. I am not hiring someone because I need another person to generate educational materials with AI.



I am hiring for professional HUMAN editorial and educational design judgment.



Please do not submit AI-generated workbook mockups or AI-generated template images that cannot function as a real editable document system.



I have worked with textbooks and instructional materials for many years and am specifically looking for someone with real experience in typography, page composition, long-form layout, educational publishing, or book/workbook design.



IDEAL EXPERIENCE:



- Editorial design

- Book / textbook / workbook layout

- Educational publishing

- Adobe InDesign

- Typesetting

- Master pages

- Paragraph / character / object styles

- Print production

- Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

- Dynamic or variable-content documents



I will provide:

- The existing AnyText logo

- The established visual direction

- The established color palette

- Several real AnyText-generated lesson packets



HOW TO APPLY:



Please send:

1. A short introduction

2. 3–5 highly relevant portfolio samples

3. Any book, textbook, workbook, educational, editorial, report, or long-form layout examples

4. Any experience with Microsoft Word / DOCX templates

5. Any experience designing for variable or dynamically generated content

6. Your project estimate and turnaround time

7. One relevant portfolio piece and three design decisions you personally made on that project and why



Please begin your application with:



FOREST READER



FINAL STANDARD:



Whether an AnyText packet is 4 pages or 14 pages, a teacher should be able to download it, make small edits, print it, staple it, and hand it to an adult ESL class—and it should still look like it came from a professional educational publisher.

title: Architectural Drafter / BIM Modeler — U.S. Projects | Part-Time to Start
description:
We are seeking a reliable architectural drafter/BIM modeler for remote, part-time work on a paid trial basis, with potential for full-time work. Excellent spoken and written English and familiarity with U.S. architectural and construction terminology are essential.



You should have experience producing U.S. architectural construction documents, models, and details, preferably for residential, school, and healthcare projects. We need someone who understands wood framing, steel studs, structural steel and metal buildings, concrete, and CMU—not just how to draw them. You should follow good industry practices for drawing standards, model organization, coordination, and quality control.



Software experience we’re looking for:



• AutoCAD: Plans, elevations, sections, details, external references, layouts, and dynamic blocks.

• Revit: Full architectural BIM models, construction documents, schedules, families, and detailing.

• Vectorworks: Architectural drawings, BIM models, sections, details, and organized sheet production.

• SketchUp: Preliminary architectural design and 3D models, particularly designs that can be brought into Revit and developed into native BIM elements.

• Twinmotion: Architectural renderings and walkthroughs.



Experience with BOTH Revit and Vectorworks is especially valuable. Tell us if you have used them together and how you exchanged or coordinated files. Also describe any projects where you developed a preliminary SketchUp design into a Revit model and construction documents.



You must communicate consistently, meet agreed deadlines, provide realistic time estimates and progress updates, and work using your own capable computer, software, and reliable internet.



To apply, please send:



1. Your résumé and a summary of your project and construction experience.

2. For each program above: the version you currently have, years of professional experience, skill rating from 0–10, and a brief description of work you’ve done with it. List other relevant software as well.

3. Three to five work samples, including construction drawings and details. Identify the portions you personally completed and remove confidential information.

4. Your computer specifications (processor, RAM, graphics card, storage, and operating system) and internet download/upload speeds, with a recent speed-test screenshot.

5. Your available hours and schedule in Philippine time, earliest start date, and expected hourly rate and currency.

6. Your contact Microsoft Teams ID.  This is the program we use to communicate



Shortlisted candidates may be offered a paid skills assessment. The paid part-time trial will help us evaluate drawing quality, construction knowledge, communication, and reliability.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist / Seller Closer — 2 Hires | Part-Time or Full-Time
description:
REIMate is hiring TWO experienced acquisitions specialists to personally call US homeowners, negotiate approved purchase offers, and get qualified single-family purchase contracts signed.



PAY AND HOURS

Base pay: $4 USD/hour. Part-time and full-time applicants welcome: 20–40 hours/week Monday–Friday. Tell us your preferred hourly, fixed salary, or base-plus-bonus arrangement. Performance bonuses can be discussed; no commission-only requirement. US business-hours availability is required, including 9am–1pm US Eastern; the full daily schedule will be agreed before hiring. Philippine hours change with US daylight saving time.



THE WORK

Use the triple dialer inside our REIMate app to call homeowner lists. Our software also handles initial SMS outreach. You personally qualify sellers, understand motivation/condition/timeline/price, present approved cash offers, handle objections, and guide owners through purchase signatures. Follow up consistently on interested sellers and unsigned contracts. Keep accurate CRM notes and communicate with sellers through closing, including dates, questions and approved addendums. Work within our buy box and approved pricing. Qualified contracts must be for single-family houses and signed by the owner on title.



REQUIRED

At least 2 years calling US homeowners for a wholesaler or investor, with personal seller negotiation and purchase-contract experience. Clear, natural spoken English and the ability to listen and handle objections in a live conversation. Quiet workspace, stable internet, headset and dependable attendance. You must personally do the work.



HELPFUL

REsimpli, xLeads, real-estate SMS CRMs, Batch Dialer, CallTools, Mojo, ReadyMode or similar dialers. We can teach our app; you should already understand homeowner conversations and follow-up.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your message with the last US city where you personally got a homeowner to sign a purchase contract.

2. Briefly describe a difficult seller negotiation, your own role, and what you said that moved it forward.

3. State your personal last-90-day numbers: signed purchase contracts, cancellations, and funded/closed deals; include lead source and approximate lead volume. Separate houses from land and personal results from team totals. If a number is unavailable, say so.

4. Attach your resume and, if you have permission to share it, a short seller-call sample or recording link. Do not share confidential seller information.

5. Give your preferred pay structure and minimum guaranteed pay, earliest start date, and availability for 20–40 hours/week during US hours.



SELECTION

A short interview includes a seller role-play: your offer is too low, followed by an unsigned-contract follow-up. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for an investor reference and a paid trial on approved leads/offers, with terms agreed in advance. We assess negotiation, qualified contracts, follow-up accuracy and seller outcomes. We are hiring people currently seeking work who can personally join our team.

description:
We're looking for a Staffing Operations Specialist to join an early-stage security technology startup as their first offshore operations hire.



This company uses technology to make it easier for businesses to access and manage security services. This role will help make sure staffing requests are handled quickly, shifts are fulfilled, and both workers and clients have the support they need.



This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working with people, solving problems, and moving quickly. You'll manage daily staffing operations, coordinate workers and schedules, support clients, and help keep operations running smoothly.



As their first offshore operations hire, you'll have a lot of ownership and a direct impact on the overall business. You'll be trained on their systems and processes, but you'll also be expected to take initiative, make decisions, work independently, and take things and run with them.



What You'll Do

- Manage daily staffing operations, including schedules, shift fulfillment, and last-minute coverage.

- Coordinate with workers and partners to make sure staffing requests are fulfilled accurately and on time.

- Communicate with workers to coordinate shifts, answer questions, and resolve issues.

- Communicate with clients about staffing needs, schedule changes, and operational issues.

- Help onboard new workers and ensure they are ready for their assignments.

- Monitor daily operations and quickly address issues as they come up.

- Manage internal communications and make sure important information gets to the right people quickly.

- Identify operational problems and find practical ways to improve processes.

- Give feedback to the product and engineering team when something isn't working or could be improved.

- Use Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI tools to solve problems, improve workflows, and work more efficiently.

- Take on different responsibilities as the company grows.



What We're Looking For 

- 2+ years of experience in staffing, workforce management, or operations, ideally in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience coordinating shifts, schedules, workers, or real-time staffing needs.

- Experience working with U.S.-based clients, workers, or operations is highly preferred.

- Previous startup experience is a strong plus.

- Comfortable communicating directly with both clients and workers.

- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle issues quickly as they come up.

- Able to work independently, take ownership, and make decisions without needing constant direction.

- Flexible and comfortable taking on different types of work as priorities change.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude Code, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar tools to solve problems, improve workflows, or automate tasks.

- Comfortable learning new systems and working with technology.

- Willing to speak up, share ideas, and give feedback when something isn't working.

- Security industry or other shift-based staffing experience is a plus, but not required.

- Must be available to work U.S. time zones.

- Reliable internet connection and a dedicated WFH setup required.



Salary and Benefits

Base salary: 65,000 PHP per month

Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays

100% WFH

Please send your resume link using a publicly accessible PDF from Google Drive. Make sure it is a direct file link (not a folder or Google Doc).

Links from Dropbox, OneDrive, OnlineJobs, or other similar platforms, as well as non-direct file links, may not be reviewed by our Talent Team.

title: Phone Closer & Customer Success Rep | Strong US Accent Required
description:
We're Orena, a fast-growing US brand that helps people get rid of their eye bags with microneedle patches. Thousands of customers order from us every month, and we want each of them to feel personally taken care of.



We're hiring 2 exceptional phone closers with a strong, natural US accent.



THE MISSION

You will call our customers a few minutes after they place their order. Not cold calls: these people just bought from us and they're happy to hear from us.

- Welcome them warmly and thank them for their order

- Get to know them: their situation, how long they've had their eye bags, what they've tried

- Reassure them and give them the tips that get the best results

- When it truly fits their situation, recommend what gives them a complete treatment, and close it naturally

Our customers are mostly Americans aged 50 to 75. They value patience, warmth, honesty and clear speech.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Excellent spoken English with a strong, natural US accent (this is a must, see the test below)

- Proven experience in phone sales and closing: you know how to build trust, ask the right questions, handle objections and ask for the sale

- Customer service experience: you're patient, warm and genuinely like talking to people

- You never sound like you're reading a script

- Reliable, organized, and you log every call properly



ACCENT TEST

We will test your accent and your selling skills before hiring: a voice recording first, then a live role-play call with us. Please only apply if you are truly confident in your spoken English and your US accent. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



SCHEDULE AND SETUP

- US business hours (our customers are in the US), Monday to Friday

- Quiet room, good headset, stable internet and a backup power solution

- Long-term position with raises based on performance



PAY

- $500/month base salary

- Commission on every sale you close, paid monthly, no cap

- Performance bonuses for top closers



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the word "RESTED" so we know you read this post.

2. Tell us in a few lines about your best sales result on the phone (what you sold, your numbers).

3. Send a 60 to 90 second voice recording (Google Drive, Vocaroo or Loom link) where you:

   a) read this out loud: "Hi, is this Robert? Hi Robert, I'm calling from Orena. First, thank you so much for your order, you made a really good choice. I hope you're doing well today? I personally like to call our new customers to understand your situation and give you a few tips so you get the best possible result. Do you have five minutes?"

   b) then tell us in your own words why you're great on the phone.



We review every recording personally. Shortlisted candidates get a live role-play call within a few days.

description:

Customer Relations Specialist

About Us



Solution Based Homebuyers is a fast-growing real estate investment company specializing in identifying, acquiring, and managing residential properties. We operate in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment and are expanding our Customer Relations team in Miami.

title: Senior AI Automation & Business Systems Lead
description:
AI Automation & Business Systems Lead





We are looking for a proactive technical leader to help us build a more organized, efficient, and automated company.



You will work directly with ownership and department leaders to understand how the business operates, identify unnecessary manual work, improve processes, and implement reliable AI tools and automations.

A major priority is developing and improving our Hermes bots and internal AI workflows using tools such as Codex and Claude Code. You will own projects from discovery and development through testing, documentation, employee training, and ongoing maintenance.



We want someone who asks good questions, identifies problems early, recommends solutions, and follows through without needing constant direction.



Compensation and working arrangement

- Up to $30 USD/hour, depending on demonstrated experience.

- Remote, with international applicants welcome.

- Intended as a long-term working relationship, beginning with a paid trial.

- Weekly hours agreed before starting.

- Must have reliable availability overlapping with U.S. Central business hours for meetings and collaboration.



What you will own

1. Work with departments to improve how the company operates

Meet with department leaders and employees to understand their workflows, tools, bottlenecks, and recurring problems.

Map processes across sales, customer service, operations, recruiting, onboarding, finance, and management.

Identify duplicate work, missed handoffs, inconsistent information, and tasks that can be simplified or automated.

Turn business needs into clear project requirements, priorities, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

Recommend process improvements before automating an inefficient process.



2. Build and maintain AI bots and automations

Audit our existing Hermes bots, integrations, and workflows; identify reliability gaps and opportunities for improvement.

Use Codex and Claude Code effectively to develop, troubleshoot, test, and maintain solutions.

Connect business tools through APIs, webhooks, scripts, and automation platforms where appropriate.

Build workflows for tasks such as reporting, task routing, follow-up tracking, data synchronization, onboarding, and internal knowledge retrieval.

D
 when to use AI and when a straightforward rule or integration will be more dependable.

Monitor deployed systems, fix failures, and improve performance over time.



3. Build our systems, processes, and SOPs

Establish an organized central knowledge base with clear document ownership and naming conventions.

Write practical SOPs, process maps, checklists, troubleshooting guides, and short training videos.

Document how systems connect, where information comes from, and which tools serve as the source of truth.

Define responsibilities, handoffs, escalation paths, and completion standards with department leaders.

Maintain an inventory of bots, automations, software subscriptions, integrations, owners, and recurring costs.



4. Lead implementation and employee adoption

Run discovery meetings and explain technical ideas in clear English.

Train employees and verify that new workflows are being used correctly.

Collect feedback and improve systems based on actual usage.

Maintain a shared project backlog and provide concise weekly updates covering progress, results, blockers, and next priorities.

Coordinate outside specialists when a project requires additional expertise.



5. Make systems reliable and maintainable

Review and test AI-generated code before deployment.

Implement appropriate logging, failure alerts, retries, duplicate prevention, and recovery procedures.

Test AI outputs against representative examples and document known limitations.

Protect sensitive business and customer information through appropriate access controls and approved tools.

Establish human review for sensitive or consequential actions.

Keep code, documentation, accounts, and deployment access under company ownership so another qualified person can maintain the systems.



Required qualifications

- Demonstrated experience deploying business automations or internal software that real teams use.

- Hands-on proficiency with both Codex and Claude Code, including explaining how you verify their work.

- Strong programming ability in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.

- Experience with APIs, webhooks, authentication, databases, Git, and troubleshooting integrations.

- Experience with at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

- Excellent spoken and written English: able to lead meetings, clarify requirements, write useful documentation, and train nontechnical employees.

- Strong project management, prioritization, and follow-through.

- Evidence that you have maintained systems after launch and handled failures.

- A proactive approach: you identify opportunities and bring recommendations rather than waiting for detailed instructions.



Helpful additional experience

Insurance, financial services, or another business handling sensitive customer information.

CRM systems, sales operations, reporting, and customer service workflows.

Internal AI assistants, knowledge bases, and document retrieval.

Process improvement, SOP development, and organizational change.

Working directly with owners and department heads at a growing company.

Direct experience with our particular Hermes implementation is helpful. Candidates with strong relevant bot and automation experience must be able to learn and assess the existing setup.



What success looks like in the first 90 days

First 30 days: Meet department leaders, audit existing tools and Hermes bots, document priority workflows, establish baseline metrics, and deliver a ranked improvement roadmap plus an initial useful improvement.



By 60 days: Deploy an agreed first group of automations, document them, train users, and establish monitoring and support procedures.



By 90 days: Demonstrate measurable improvements in selected workflows, establish a repeatable delivery process, and maintain a clear roadmap for the next quarter.



We will evaluate success through time saved, reduced errors, faster turnaround, employee adoption, system reliability, and operating cost.



How to apply

Please include:

- Your hourly rate, location, weekly availability, and overlap with U.S. Central business hours.

- A short introduction video explaining a business process you improved.

- Two relevant project examples describing the problem, your personal contribution, tools used, measurable results, and maintenance after launch. Confidential examples may be anonymized.

- How you have used Codex and Claude Code, including an example of catching an error in AI-generated work.

- An example SOP, process map, or technical document you personally created.

- Your approach to your first two weeks in this role.

- Whether you personally perform the work and whether any subcontractors would be involved.

- Finalists will complete a short paid practical assessment and discuss their work live.

Remote Bankruptcy Paralegal



Schedule Flexibility: May occasionally require additional hours outside the regular schedule, including evenings or weekends, as needed.





Job Overview: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Remote Bankruptcy Paralegal to support the Bankruptcy Department with court docket research, business development, case tracking, and general legal support. This role involves reviewing bankruptcy filings through PACER, identifying relevant parties and potential business opportunities, and preparing concise, professional presentations to support attorneys' outreach efforts.



The ideal candidate has experience in paralegal or legal support work, is comfortable navigating bankruptcy court records, and possesses strong research, writing, and presentation skills. This position requires accuracy, discretion, and the ability to work independently while collaborating with attorneys.





Key Responsibilities:

Bankruptcy Research and Lead Identification: Search and review PACER bankruptcy dockets to identify new filings, debtors, creditors, claims, motions, and other relevant case developments. Analyze findings to identify potential business development opportunities for the firm.



Presentation Development: Create clear, concise, and professional pitch decks using Microsoft PowerPoint to summarize relevant case information and support attorneys' business development and outreach efforts.



Case and Lead Tracking: Maintain organized logs of new cases, potential leads, relevant parties, follow-up activities, and important case dates and deadlines.



General Paralegal Support: Assist with document preparation, filing support, legal research, and other administrative tasks related to bankruptcy matters.



Case File Management: Organize and maintain electronic case files, court documents, research materials, and related records.



Research Summaries and Reporting: Prepare accurate, concise summaries of court filings and research findings to help attorneys assess relevant developments and make informed decisions.



Confidentiality and Compliance: Handle sensitive legal and business information with discretion and follow applicable firm procedures for confidentiality and document management.





Required Skills & Qualifications:

Previous experience as a paralegal or legal assistant, preferably in bankruptcy, litigation, or a related legal practice.



Familiarity with bankruptcy proceedings, court filings, and legal terminology.



Hands-on experience using PACER to search bankruptcy dockets and review court records.



Strong legal research and analytical skills, with the ability to identify relevant information and summarize complex legal documents clearly.



Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, with the ability to create polished, professional presentations.



Excellent written English and strong communication skills.

Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and time management, with the ability to manage multiple cases, leads, and deadlines independently.

Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential legal and business information.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant 

Full-Time | Remote / Offshore 



Position Summary 

We are seeking a Staff Accountant to support the accounting operations of a growing, multi-entity real estate organization. The position will work closely with finance leadership and support general ledger accounting, accounts payable, balance sheet reconciliations, expense management, and monthly and annual close activities. 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

General Ledger & Balance Sheet Accounting 

Maintain general ledger records and prepare recurring and adjusting journal entries across multiple legal entities. 

Prepare and reconcile bank, credit card, asset, liability, intercompany, and other balance sheet accounts, including supporting schedules for fixed assets, depreciation, prepaids, accruals, and debt. 

Research reconciliation differences, unusual balances, and account activity and communicate findings to finance leadership. 



Accounts Payable & Expense Management 

Manage day-to-day accounts payable, including invoice coding, approval routing, vendor records, payment preparation, and follow-up on outstanding items. 

Ensure expenses are recorded to the appropriate entity, account, property, department, and accounting period. 

Support implementation and ongoing administration of an expense management platform, including transaction review, receipts, coding, reimbursements, and issue resolution. 



Month-End & Year-End Close 

Complete assigned close procedures, including reconciliations, accruals, reclassifications, depreciation, amortization, and supporting schedules. 

Review account activity for missing transactions, classification issues, unusual balances, and significant fluctuations. 

Assist with financial statement preparation and provide supporting documentation for external tax, accounting, and other professional service providers. 



Multi-Entity & Accounting Operations 

Record and reconcile transactions across affiliated entities, including intercompany and due-to/due-from balances. 

Work with property-level accounting reports and supporting information from property management systems and third-party property managers. 

Maintain organized accounting records and assist with accounting procedures, controls, system improvements, and recurring close processes. 





Required Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 

3-5 years of professional accounting experience. 

Strong understanding of accrual accounting, journal entries, general ledger accounting, balance sheet reconciliations, accounts payable, and month-end close. 

Experience preparing account reconciliations and maintaining supporting schedules. 

Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills. 

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 

Strong written and spoken English communication skills and ability to manage multiple responsibilities in a remote environment. 





Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with multi-entity accounting and intercompany reconciliations. 

Experience in real estate, property management, construction, or real estate development accounting. 

Experience with U.S. GAAP and U.S.-based accounting teams. 

Experience with QuickBooks or similar accounting systems and property management systems such as Entrata. 





Work Arrangement 

Full-time remote / offshore position with regular working-hour overlap with the U.S. Mountain Time Zone. 

The position will work directly with U.S.-based accounting and finance leadership, with occasional additional flexibility during month-end and year-end close.

title: Wordpress Developer
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based digital marketing agency looking for a full-time Web Developer to build, maintain, and optimize websites for our clients.



You will work across a live portfolio of 30+ client sites in home services, healthcare, med spas, hospitality, professional services, and e-commerce catalogs ranging from a handful of products to several thousand SKUs. On any given week you might be building a new Elementor landing page for a PPC campaign, fixing a broken checkout on a WooCommerce store, migrating a site to a new host, or cutting a page's load time in half.



WORK SCHEDULE



- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST (U.S. Eastern Time)

- 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippines Time

- 40 hours per week

- Monday to Friday



HOW WE WORK (PLEASE READ THIS PART)



Tasks come to you detailed and specified, not as one-line requests. A typical ticket includes the target URL, a reference design or comp, the exact copy, the assets, the acceptance criteria, and which staging or live environment to work in. We do this on purpose. You should not have to guess what "make the hero better" means. In exchange, we expect the work to come back matching the spec, tested on mobile and desktop, published to the correct environment, and reported back with a live link, not left sitting in an editor.



We are also an AI-assisted shop. Our team uses Claude (Anthropic's AI) daily as part of real production work: generating and reviewing code, scripting bulk content and product updates, driving WordPress and Shopify through their APIs, auditing pages, and automating the repetitive parts of site maintenance. You are not expected to arrive as an expert in this. You are expected to be genuinely interested in it and willing to learn, because it is how we move fast across this many client sites. If you already use Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar tools in your development workflow, tell us how in your application.



To be clear on the other side of that: AI helps you write and check the work, it does not excuse it. You own what you publish. We would rather you slow down and verify on the live URL than ship something that "should" work.



TOOLS WE USE



- Microsoft Teams for daily communication and standups

- ClickUp / Trello / Asana for task and project management

- Google Drive for documentation, assets, and tracking

- WordPress / Elementor (heaviest) / Divi / Gutenberg

- Shopify (themes, Liquid, admin, apps)

- WooCommerce

- Claude and AI tooling for development and automation

- Google Search Console and Google Analytics (GA4)

- Ahrefs / SEMrush / Screaming Frog

- PageSpeed Insights / GTmetrix

- cPanel, SiteGround, Hostinger, Cloudflare, and similar hosting stacks

- Canva or similar for light graphics



RESPONSIBILITIES



Build and maintain



- Build, edit, and maintain WordPress websites across multiple client accounts at the same time

- Build pages in Elementor to match a provided design comp or reference site, accurately, including spacing, typography, color tokens, and mobile breakpoints

- Build and maintain Shopify stores: product pages, collections, theme sections, navigation, and front-end adjustments in HTML, CSS, and Liquid

- Create and update landing pages, service pages, location pages, blog pages, and site sections from written specs

- Customize WordPress themes, child themes, and page builder templates, including light PHP work where needed

- Manage WooCommerce catalogs: products, variations, categories, pricing, and bulk imports and updates

- Handle site migrations, staging-to-live pushes, DNS changes, and hosting moves



Fix and optimize



- Troubleshoot plugin conflicts, broken layouts, mobile responsiveness issues, form failures, SMTP and
 delivery problems, and general site errors independently, and document what you found

- Improve site speed and Core Web Vitals: caching, image optimization and WebP conversion, script and CSS cleanup, render-blocking fixes

- Keep sites secure and current with backups, plugin and theme updates, cleanup of abandoned plugins, and basic hardening



SEO and tracking



- Execute on-page and basic technical SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, image alt text, internal linking, redirects, schema where specified, sitemap and indexing checks

- Publish and format blog posts with correct headings, images, links, and SEO fields

- Implement on-page updates handed down from our SEO team's strategy

- Set up and verify Google Search Console, GA4, conversion tracking, and pixels when needed



Work with the team



- Collaborate with our SEO, PPC, social, and design staff to support live campaigns, often on a deadline tied to an ad launch

- Provide clear daily written updates: what you completed, what is blocked, and the live links to verify

- Flag problems early. A task that turns out to be twice the size it looked is fine. Finding that out on the due date is not.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2 to 3+ years hands-on, professional experience building and managing WordPress sites

- Strong Elementor skills specifically. You can rebuild a design comp in Elementor without it falling apart on mobile

- Experience with Shopify: themes, product pages, collections, and store updates

- Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals. Basic PHP is a strong plus

- Basic Shopify Liquid knowledge preferred

- Working knowledge of WooCommerce

- Strong grasp of on-page and basic technical SEO

- Proven experience improving page speed, mobile responsiveness, and user experience

- Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, PageSpeed Insights, and standard SEO tools

- Able to troubleshoot independently. You research, test, and solve before escalating

- Genuine attention to detail on layouts, links, images, and SEO fields. You check your own work on the live URL before calling it done

- Able to juggle multiple client sites and deadlines without dropping tasks

- Strong written English, since most of our communication is written

- Self-motivated and reliable on the U.S. night shift

- Reliable internet connection and your own computer or laptop

- Interest in AI-assisted development (Claude or similar). Prior experience is a bonus, not a requirement



NICE TO HAVE



- Agency experience

- Site migrations, DNS, cPanel, Cloudflare, and hosting administration

- Git and version control

- Working with REST APIs (WordPress REST API, Shopify Admin API)

- Experience with large product catalogs or bulk data imports

- Custom plugin or theme development



TO APPLY



- Write the word "Web" at the top of your application

- Include links to websites you have built, managed, or optimized: WordPress sites, Shopify stores, and landing pages

- For each link, write a short description of your specific role: design, development, maintenance, speed optimization, SEO, or troubleshooting. Tell us what you actually did, not what the agency did

- Describe one website problem you diagnosed and fixed yourself, and how you found it

- If you use AI tools in your development work, tell us which ones and what you use them for



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.
