title: Meme and Trend Content Creator for a Pre-Launch US Drink Brand (Instagram Reels)
description:
About us

We're a pre-launch US drink brand making a no-sugar strawberry water enhancer. We're pre-revenue and building a waitlist before launch. That means a modest base salary now, with real room to grow for someone who goes all in and thinks long term.



The role

You create the content. That's the whole job. Memes, trends, carousels and short-form Reels built to get shared and get people to join our waitlist. No talking-head videos. You create the content and load it into our content calendar, ready to go. We handle posting at US times.



What you'll make

- 5 Instagram Trial Reels a day, with more welcome once quality is consistent

- Memes, trend remixes and carousels

- Every piece uploaded to our Google Drive and added to our Notion content calendar a day ahead, with the caption, on-screen text and the trending audio to use

- A short weekly list of US trends you're seeing and how we should use them



Who you are

- Chronically online. You know what's trending on US Instagram this week, not last month.

- You can explain why something went viral and why something flopped.

- Fluent in spoken and written English

- You edit your own videos from start to finish (CapCut, Premiere or similar)

- You already use the latest AI tools to work faster (editing, images, captions) and have your own paid access to them.

- Comfortable working in Notion and Google Drive

- You want feedback and want to get better every week.

- You want to be a creative director one day.

- A plus: you're comfortable filming yourself for skits, POVs or trends.



Pay

- Base: $300 to $550 per month, depending on experience

- Bonus: $25 for every 100 new waitlist signups from your content. These are tracked through your own signup link, and signups must still be subscribed after 30 days to count.

- You cover the cost of your own software and AI tools.



Growth

This role starts as meme and trend creator. As the brand launches and grows, the right person grows into leading our creative. We want someone who wants to build something from day one, not just fill hours.



How we hire

- Shortlisted applicants get a paid test ($20) to make 3 pieces for us within 48 hours.

- The best fit gets a paid 2-week trial.

- If it works, this becomes a long-term full-time role.



How to apply

Put STRAWBERRY in your subject line. Applications without it won't be read. Then send:

- Links to 3 memes, Reels or carousels you made that performed well, with view or share numbers

- One US Instagram trend from this week and how you'd use it for a drink brand

- The AI tools you use and what you use each one for

- A 30 to 60 second voice note or video of yourself, in English, telling us about a recent trend you loved

- Your expected monthly rate

title: Travel Agent Servicing Canadian Clients

We are rapidly expanding our operations with our new proprietary AI booking concierge, Captain Sunny, and we need a dynamic, articulate, and hungry Travel Sales Closer to take incoming qualified warm leads across the finish line over the phone.

Read This Carefully Before Applying: We are not looking for a data-entry clerk, an
 typist, or someone who hides behind
 Messenger sending endless text quotes. Our AI already handles initial trip research and quotes. Your job is to pick up the phone, build trust, review curated itineraries live with Canadian travelers, and collect the booking deposit.

If you are intimidated by picking up the phone and closing sales, please do not apply.

If you have a clear speaking voice, love travel, know how to steer a conversation to a closed deposit, and want to earn substantial uncapped performance commissions on top of guaranteed base pay, this is your dream role.

Key Responsibilities:

Close Inbound Warm Leads on the Phone: Transition leads generated by our marketing and AI concierge into scheduled phone consultations (outbound dialing to booked appointments and fast follow-ups).

Consultative Selling: Walk Canadian clients through custom cruise, all-inclusive, and tour packages; present unadvertised perks, upgrades, and SunClub Rewards privileges to close deposits on the call.

Proactive Follow-up Pipeline: Maintain a tight follow-up system with prospects who requested consultations—calling them back until a definitive decision is reached.

Supplier Booking & Admin: Finalize reservations with major Canadian and global travel suppliers, process payments securely, and deliver travel documentation.

Client Retention & Advocacy: Serve as the client's dedicated personal travel advocate before departure and follow up post-trip for rebooking and referrals.

Mandatory Qualifications (Do Not Apply Without These):

1. Minimum 2 Years of Proven Sales Closing Experience: You must have a demonstrable track record of selling over the phone and asking for the sale/credit card. Preference given to applicants with previous Canadian experience. 

2. Impeccable Verbal & Written English: Neutral North American accent or easily understandable, clear, and highly engaging telephone presence.

3. North American Working Hours: Must be fully committed to working full-time on Pacific/Eastern Standard Time (Canadian business hours) with consistent, reliable attendance.

4. Phone Confidence: Zero phone reluctance. You view the phone as your primary closing weapon, not chat apps.

5. Home Office Setup: High-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps with backup option), noise-canceling headset, and a quiet, distraction-free home office environment.

Huge Pluses (Preferred):

Direct prior experience booking with Canadian suppliers (e.g., Sunwing, Air Canada Vacations, WestJet Vacations, Transat, TravelBrands, Expedia TAAP, major cruise lines). We are members of Travel Leaders Consortium

Familiarity with travel booking CRM systems

Compensation & Perks:

Starting Base Salary: $600 – $800 USD per month (based on depth of experience and Canadian supplier knowledge).

Uncapped Sales Commissions: Earn tiered commission on closed bookings and travel package add-ons. High performers can significantly multiply their base pay.

Warm Inbound Leads: No cold calling. Leads are generated through our digital media channels, direct-response ads, and our proprietary AI platform.

Full Training & Scripts: Complete access to our consultative closing framework, supplier training, and direct support from management.

Long-Term Career Growth: Stable full-time position with an established Canadian travel enterprise.

HOW TO APPLY (Strict Screening Step):

We receive hundreds of generic applications. To prove you pay attention to detail and have the verbal communication skills required for this phone-closing role, you must follow these instructions:

1. Change the subject line of your application to:

"I Am Your Next Travel Closer – [Your Full Name]"

2. Record a 60-to-90 second audio recording (using 
, Loom, or a shareable Google Drive link) answering these two questions:

Why do you prefer selling over the phone instead of messaging apps or
?

What was the most exciting vacation package you personally sold or experienced, and how did you get the customer to say YES?

3. Include a link to your resume and briefly list the specific travel suppliers, booking engines, or GDS platforms you have used.

Applications that do not include the audio link or use the incorrect subject line will be deleted immediately without review.

title: YouTube Video Podcast Editor
description:
Role (Overview of the Position)

Fertility Friday Publishing — a High-Level Women's Health and Fertility Coaching Business — is looking for a skilled YouTube Video Podcast Editor to join our content production team on a per-video basis.



We are launching a video podcast on YouTube and need an editor who can take raw podcast recordings and turn them into polished, professional, engaging video episodes. Our episodes will be 10 to 20 minutes and will feature multi-camera setups.



This is an execution-focused, deliverable-based role. You will receive raw footage, audio files, and creative direction, and you will deliver completed, publish-ready YouTube videos on a consistent schedule. Thoughtful creative input is welcome — if you see a way to make the final product better, we want to hear it — but the heart of this role is reliable, high-quality editing output, not strategy or content planning.



It's a great fit for someone who takes pride in clean, professional edits, has a sharp eye for pacing and visual quality, delivers on time without reminders, and enjoys the craft of making videos that hold a viewer's attention.



Responsibilities (Tasks Associated with the Role)

- Editing raw podcast video recordings (10–20 minutes) into polished, publish-ready YouTube episodes.

- Seamlessly syncing and cutting between multiple camera angles to create a dynamic, professional viewing experience.

- Syncing audio and video tracks cleanly, ensuring perfect alignment throughout.

- Adding on-brand graphics, lower thirds, text overlays, background images, and visual elements that enhance the content without cluttering it.

- Creating and maintaining a branded video intro (approximately 15–30 seconds) and outro, and applying them consistently across episodes.

- Color correcting and adjusting footage for a clean, consistent visual quality.

- Exporting final videos in YouTube-optimized formats and specs.

- Incorporating revision notes promptly and accurately.

- Designing eye-catching YouTube thumbnails for each episode that are on-brand, visually compelling, and optimized for click-through (strong plus — not required, but a significant advantage).

- Communicating any issues, questions, or delays proactively — before the deadline, not after.



Requirements (Expected Proficiencies)

- Minimum 2 years of experience editing podcast or interview-style videos for YouTube — this is non-negotiable. We need someone who already knows how to edit this content format and can demonstrate it.

- Proficient in professional editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent).

- Demonstrated skill with multi-camera editing — syncing, cutting between angles, and maintaining a natural flow.

- Competent with motion graphics, text overlays, lower thirds, and visual enhancements (After Effects, Canva, or similar tools are a plus).

- Strong audio-video sync skills and basic audio cleanup ability.

- Reliable and accountable — you meet deadlines, communicate clearly, and own your work, including mistakes.

- A try-first problem-solver — when something is unclear, you make a reasonable attempt or do your own research before asking, and when you do ask, the question is specific.

- Comfortable receiving direct feedback and revision notes without taking it personally — you see revisions as part of producing great work.

- Fluent enough in written English for clear communication via
 and project management tools.

- Experience with YouTube upload specs, formats, and best practices.

- Experience designing YouTube thumbnails (Canva, Photoshop, or similar) is a strong plus — if you can deliver both the edit and the thumbnail, that's a significant advantage.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted editing tools is a plus, but not required.





What We're Not Looking For:

This role is not a fit if you:

- Have experience only with short-form social media clips (Reels, TikToks, Shorts) but not long-form YouTube video editing.

- Prefer to work without deadlines or structured feedback cycles.

- Are looking for a strategy or creative director role — this is hands-on editing work.

- Cannot provide links to published YouTube videos you have edited.



How Success is Measured in this Role:

- Turnaround Time — Completed edits are delivered within the agreed timeframe, consistently and without reminders.

- Edit Quality — Videos are polished, cuts are clean and natural, audio is perfectly synced, graphics are on-brand, and the final product looks professional upon first delivery.

- Responsiveness & Communication — Messages are replied to within 24 hours. Blockers, delays, or questions are raised proactively and specifically — before the deadline is missed, not after.

- Revision Turnaround — Revision notes are incorporated accurately and returned promptly, without the same corrections needing to be repeated.



How to Apply

To be considered for this position, please submit the following:

- Complete the application form (all questions completed): 

- Link to your CV / resume.

- Links to 1–2 YouTube channels or specific YouTube videos where you did the editing. This is required. We want to see your actual published work — the quality, pacing, graphics, and camera-angle cuts in a real video. Please link directly to the YouTube video(s).



This description is not all-inclusive and certain activities, duties, or responsibilities may be required of the employee as needed.

title: Instagram Reel Cover Designer – Aesthetic Feeds for Clients (Project-based)
description:
Hi! I'm Laura, I run a social media agency based in the Netherlands.

The project:

- I will give you the real footage of the client

- Your job is to have a look at the client's current Instagram feed and design the reel covers in a way that the whole feed looks aesthetic and consistent

- Feel free to suggest a new order for the grid too. If you have an idea how the feed would look better, I'm open to hear it!

- Make sure the text is readable and visible on the Instagram feed (the grid crops covers, so you need to know the right format)

- No AI-generated images, only the client's real footage

- Make small changes based on my feedback



How it works:

- First a small paid trial: you design 3 covers

- If I love your work, you continue with the other 47 covers



What I'm looking for:

- You have real experience creating aesthetic Instagram feeds for clients

- You have a great eye for design, fonts, colors and layout

- You know Canva very well

- Photoshop is a plus, for example for clean cut-outs

- CapCut is a plus, for example to take nice still frames from the videos

- Experience with a feed planning app (e.g. Preview, Planoly or UNUM) is a plus

- You are reliable, communicate well and meet deadlines

- Good English



Details:

- $4 per hour

- Possibility to continue on an ongoing basis for my other clients

- Fully remote, communication via WhatsApp



How to apply:

Please send me 3–5 examples of real Instagram feeds or reel covers you designed for clients (links to the Instagram accounts are best). No AI-generated work please, I want to see your real designs.



IMPORTANT: I get many automatic AI answers, so I only reply to people who really read this post. To show me you read it, please:

1) Start your message with the words "Aesthetic feed"

2) Tell me in your own words which of your examples is your favorite and why (2–3 sentences is enough)

3) Tell me how many hours you think you need for the 50 covers



Applications without this will not be answered.



Thank you and I'm looking forward to seeing your work!

Laura

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



A note on AI: we build AI products, so we recognize AI-generated writing immediately. Any application or answer written by AI will be discarded without a reply. We want to hear from you, in your own words.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers,
, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use NinjaOne RMM for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Manage SentinelOne endpoint security, including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone,
, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**

Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.

title: Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
About Us

Squad Health provides navigation services and software to US medical practices to remove barriers to treatment — especially prescription access.

Our services include benefits investigation, prior authorization submission, patient assistance enrollment, pharmacy coordination, and patient engagement.

Our team members operate as extensions of provider offices, supporting clinical staff through accurate documentation and consistent follow-up.



Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Prior Authorization Specialist with strong background in US specialty medication authorizations. This role requires reviewing clinical documentation, verifying insurance benefits, submitting medication authorizations, and managing denials and appeals efficiently.



Duties

Verify insurance benefits for drug and procedure orders (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid)

Determine pharmacy vs. medical benefit requirements when applicable

Obtain appropriate authorizations by completing payer-specific forms and clinical questionnaires

Review medical notes, diagnosis information, and treatment history to answer clinical questions accurately

Submit and manage authorizations through, payer portals, fax, or phone

Track pending authorizations and follow up until resolution

Prioritize and manage STAT/urgent requests appropriately

Communicate with MDs and NPs regarding denials, treatment plan updates, and Letters of Medical Necessity (LMNs)

Assist patients with copay assistance or patient assistance programs when needed

Enroll patients into navigation programs and obtain consent

Document all actions clearly in internal systems and case trackers

Participate in team meetings to resolve patient access challenges and improve workflow



Required Skills & Experience

Minimum 2 years of US-based specialty medication prior authorization experience

Experience managing other PA Specialists preferred

Direct experience supporting GI, Dermatology, Rheumatology, Urology and Allergy medication authorizations required

Strong understanding of US insurance plans (Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid)

Experience reviewing EMR/EHR clinical documentation

Strong attention to detail and structured documentation habits

Fluent English (written and verbal)

Ability to work full-time night shift aligned with EST hours



To apply:

Subject: Prior Authorization Specialist

Answer these questions in your message:

1. A summary of your relevant experience in United States-based prior authorizations?

2. List 5 medications for which you have frequently completed prior authorizations and can discuss during an interview?

3. Have you worked in a hospital or doctor's office completing medication prior authorizations? If so, please elaborate what platforms you have used to submit these

4. Why are you looking to leave (or have already left) your previous employer?

title: Process Design Assistant
description:
Process Design Assistant



Keeping it simple, the person for this position MUST have BOTH of the following:



-Property management operations experience (ops management; implementing, coordinating, or improving processes across leasing, resident services, or maintenance) AND/OR a high degree of technical capability (building automations, workflows, or CRM systems)

-AND the ability to communicate clearly and confidently in English with clients



If you have both of these, we would love to hear from you. More details are provided below.



This role IS: Hands-on and client-facing. The core challenge is turning how a property management company actually operates into processes that run reliably in its software, then walking clients through them with confidence. You'll thrive here if you enjoy both building the solution and explaining it.



This role is NOT: A solo, build-it-your-own-way job. If you get energized by making proven tools do more, rather than starting from scratch on your own, you'll fit right in. And if your background is purely accounting, or you'd rather build without talking to clients, this likely isn't the right fit.



Mission of the role



The objective of this position is to deliver the ProfitCoach Experience (customized solutions, ease of doing business, and extraordinary service) by designing, implementing, monitoring, and improving property management processes for multiple property management companies that use ProfitCoach services.

You'll work directly with property management clients and our internal team, so clear, confident communication matters as much as building skill.



Key responsibilities



Design and implementation (75%)

Quality assurance (5%)

-Ensure processes are designed and optimized in alignment with the PM Ops Standards and industry best practices.

-Continuous improvement (5%)

-Champion a culture of continuous process development and improvement.

-Collaborate with internal teams to foster a mindset of efficiency and innovation.

Culture fit and core values

-Think Abundantly

-Own the Outcome

-Be Courageous

-Leverage Your Talents

-ADEPT Communication (Assess the need, Detail the solution, Energize the conversation, Provide closure, Tell the truth always)

title: Media & Operations Specialist
description:
About Kipkeh Media



Kipkeh Media is a digital media company serving the Orthodox Jewish community. Our team creates and distributes daily video content, graphics, and visual updates across our media platforms, following a consistent and time-sensitive publishing schedule.



We are seeking a dependable, organized, and proactive Operations & Media Specialist to support our daily content workflow, administrative tasks, and operational activities. The ideal candidate can work independently, pay close attention to detail, and ensure assigned tasks are completed accurately and on time.



### What We Expect



We value individuals who take responsibility for their work, think ahead, and follow through on commitments. You should be comfortable managing multiple assignments, organizing priorities, maintaining proper documentation, and addressing problems before they affect deadlines.



This is a stable, full-time remote opportunity with guaranteed compensation for 40 hours per week. We expect employees to remain focused during their scheduled working hours, communicate professionally, and consistently deliver quality work. Applicants must be able to work independently without needing frequent reminders or supervision.



 Two-Week Paid Evaluation



The position begins with a two-week paid trial period at an agreed hourly rate of **$4.00–$6.00 USD**, depending on qualifications and experience.



During this period, we will evaluate your reliability, work quality, attention to detail, communication, initiative, accuracy in maintaining trackers, and ability to meet deadlines.



Candidates who successfully meet our expectations may proceed to the regular full-time arrangement. Continued employment will depend on satisfactory performance throughout the evaluation period.



Key Responsibilities

Media Preparation & Publishing Support:Organize, prepare, and check daily WhatsApp Status videos and visual content. Ensure files are properly sequenced, branded, and ready for timely publication.



Basic Video & Graphic Editing: Work with CapCut and Canva to make simple video adjustments, including trimming footage, removing unnecessary portions, resizing content, and applying approved branding elements such as logos and watermarks.



Client & Vendor Communication:Assist with gathering creative materials, clarifying project requirements, coordinating deliverables, and following up on outstanding assets or approvals.



Accounts & Payment Follow-Up: Keep track of pending client payments, monitor outstanding balances, send professional payment reminders, and raise concerns to the appropriate manager.



Documentation & Digital Organization: Update Google Sheets, operational trackers, dashboards, and shared Google Drive folders to ensure information remains accurate, organized, and accessible.



Workload & Deadline Coordination: Maintain visibility over assigned tasks, upcoming deliverables, and deadlines. Plan daily work accordingly and ensure assignments are completed on schedule.



Slack Monitoring & Shift Reporting: Monitor assigned Slack channels, respond to relevant requests, coordinate task updates, and prepare clear reports and handoff notes for the Operations Manager.



Problem Identification & Escalation: Identify missing resources, inaccessible links, incomplete instructions, and other workflow issues. Communicate concerns promptly and follow through until they are addressed.



### Position Details



Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote

Compensation:$4.00–$6.00 USD per hour, depending on experience

Work Hours: 40 hours per week

Work Schedule:Sunday night through Thursday night (Eastern Time)



Available Shifts:



Shift 1: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET

Shift 2: 3:00 AM–12:00 PM ET



Both schedules include a one-hour break. Applicants must be comfortable committing to the assigned shift consistently.



 Qualifications & Requirements



Professional Experience:At least 1–2 years of experience providing administrative, operational, or media-related support to US-based companies, agencies, or business owners.



Technical Knowledge: Practical experience using CapCut, Canva, Google Sheets, Google Docs, Google Drive, Gmail, and Slack.



Communication Skills: Good written and verbal English skills. Must be capable of communicating clearly and professionally with internal teams, clients, and external vendors.



Organization & Accountability: Strong ability to prioritize assignments, manage deadlines, maintain documentation, and complete responsibilities with minimal supervision.



Computer & Workstation Requirements:

- A computer with at least 16 GB RAM and a processor suitable for basic video editing.

- Applicants with less than 16 GB RAM must indicate whether their device supports a memory upgrade.

- Stable primary internet connection and a backup internet option.

- Reliable backup electricity through a UPS, inverter, or generator.

- A dedicated and professional home workstation.



 How to Apply



Please read and follow each instruction carefully. Applications that do not include the requested information or contain inaccessible links may not be considered.



1.
 Subject



Use the following format:



[Your Full Name] – Operations & Media Specialist



2. Compensation & Availability



Confirm that you are comfortable with the $4.00–$6.00 USD hourly compensation range, a 40-hour workweek, the assigned Eastern Time shift, and the initial two-week paid evaluation.



3. Previous US-Based Work Experience



Briefly describe your most recent US-based client or employer, including the type of business, your main responsibilities, and how long you worked with them.



Please include the same information in your resume.



4. Video Editing Portfolio



Provide a Google Drive folder, Loom recording, or portfolio link containing 1–2 examples of your previous editing work.



Samples should demonstrate basic editing abilities such as trimming, resizing, removing unnecessary footage, or adding logos and watermarks.



5. Practical Scenario



Consider the following situation:



You receive an assignment on Monday with a Thursday afternoon deadline. On Tuesday morning, you discover that one of the essential asset links is no longer working.



Explain how you would handle the situation. Include how you would communicate the problem, who you would notify, what follow-up actions you would take, and how you would ensure the assignment stays on schedule.



6. Resume, Computer Specifications & Workstation



Submit the following:



- Updated resume.

- Screenshot showing your computer's processor (CPU) and RAM specifications.

- Primary internet connection download and upload speed results.

- Description of your backup internet connection.

- Description of your backup power source.

- Clear photo of your dedicated workstation.



You may use Google Drive or another accessible file-sharing platform. Make sure all links are viewable and do not require additional access permissions.



Final Note



We are looking for someone who is organized, responsible, and capable of combining basic media production skills with strong administrative and operational abilities.



The right candidate should be someone who takes ownership of assigned tasks, communicates proactively, maintains accurate records, and consistently follows through without needing constant supervision.



If you are confident in your ability to meet these expectations and are looking for a stable, long-term remote opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

title: Outbound Sales Representative — Cold & Warm Calling  (Remote, Full-Time/Part-Time)
description:
Company: Harvest Panel Systems (Harvest Panels) — Oklahoma, USA Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, US Central Time business hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT)  - Pay $8 base + commission/bonus



About Us

Harvest Panel Systems distributes insulated metal panels (IMPs), cooler doors and trim from Oklahoma to customers across the US. We serve contractors, builders and owners of cold storage facilities, walk-in coolers and freezers, cultivation and grow rooms, food processing plants, cleanrooms and metal buildings. Our panels are in stock and ship nationwide.



The Role

You will be the voice of Harvest Panels on the phone. You will make outbound cold calls, call warm leads from our
 campaigns and website, and follow up on quotes until they close. You will work hand-in-hand with our
 campaign specialist so every lead gets the right call at the right time. Because you will speak directly with American contractors and business owners, perfect spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent is essential.



Responsibilities

• Make 60–100+ outbound calls per day to contractors, builders and facility owners

• Call warm leads who opened, clicked or replied to our
 campaigns, and inbound web inquiries

• Follow up on sent quotes, estimates and past conversations

• Qualify leads: project type, size (square footage), timeline, location and decision-maker

• Book calls and estimate requests for our sales team; collect floor plans and project details

• Log every call, outcome, note and next step in Pipedrive (our CRM) the same day

• Coordinate with the
 specialist on timing, talk tracks and lead priorities

• Leave clear, professional voi
s and send short follow-up
s after calls

• Report daily call numbers and weekly results (connects, conversations, appointments, quotes)



Requirements

• Native-level spoken English with a neutral, minimal accent — this is the #1 requirement

• 2+ years of outbound sales or cold-calling experience for US clients (B2B strongly preferred)

• Confident, friendly and persistent; comfortable handling objections and rejection

• CRM experience; Pipedrive preferred (HubSpot or Salesforce also considered)

• Able to learn technical product details (panel thickness, R-values, door types) and explain them simply

• High-quality USB headset with noise cancelling, quiet workspace, reliable internet (25+ Mbps) and backup power/internet

• Available to work US Central Time business hours



Nice to Have

• Experience selling construction, building materials, HVAC/refrigeration or industrial products

• Experience with dialers (Aircall, RingCentral, JustCall, Kixie or similar)



How to Apply

Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



1. Your resume

2. Links to your website, portfolio or LinkedIn (if applicable)

3. A short list of past work and projects you have handled (company or industry, your role, and results if available)

4. A voice recording (MP3 or a Vocaroo/Google Drive link) of you reading the script below in a natural, conversational sales tone. Do not use any audio editing or filters. Record in one take, 1–2 minutes

5. Your expected monthly rate in USD and your available start date



Voice Recording Script (for Job Ad 2 applicants)

Applicants read this aloud as if on a live cold call. It runs about 90 seconds and includes product terms, numbers, US place names and an objection, so you can judge accent, pronunciation, pacing and tone.

Instructions for applicants: Read the script below as if you are speaking to a real contractor on the phone. Sound natural and friendly, not robotic. Words in [brackets] are for you to fill in (use your own first name).



Opening

"Hi, is this Mike? Great. Mike, this is [Your Name] with Harvest Panel Systems out of Oklahoma. I know I'm catching you out of the blue, so I'll be quick. Do you have about thirty seconds?"



Reason for the call

"Thanks. We supply insulated metal panels, cooler doors and trim to contractors building cold storage, walk-in coolers and freezers, grow rooms and food processing facilities. I'm calling because a lot of builders we talk to are dealing with long lead times and rising material costs, and we've been able to help with both."



Value

"Our panels combine the wall, the insulation, the vapor barrier and the finish in one product, so crews can install them much faster than traditional framing. Our four-inch panel is rated R-thirty, and we keep stock lengths of ten, twelve, fourteen, sixteen and twenty feet ready to ship from our warehouse in Piedmont, Oklahoma. Stock orders can usually reach you anywhere in the continental U.S. within forty-eight hours after they leave our facility."



Handling an objection

"Totally understand you already have a supplier. Most of our customers did too. We're not asking you to switch today. We just offer a best price guarantee, so if you send us a competitor's written quote, we'll take a look and match it. That way you've got a reliable backup when your usual supplier is backordered."



Close

"Do you have any projects coming up in the next three to six months? If you can send over a floor plan, our team will put together a free estimate and design layout for you. What's the best
 to send that to? Perfect. I'll send it over today and give you a follow-up call on Thursday. Thanks for your time, Mike, and have a great afternoon."

1. Heart Rate - raise your heart rate by doing some Exercise

2. Eating right

3. Read

4. ONE BIG THING (towards your biggest goal)

5. Spread Joy

I want to build a mobile app to help people take score on their day each day (like a habit tracker).

eventually, I see the app needing to integrate with a calendar so when the user identifies their 5 critical actions (they can schedule them on their calendar). this is a "nice to have" feature but not necessary for the MVP

description:
***At Polaris, we’re on the lookout for a driven, detail-oriented, and marketing-savvy Marketing and Acquisitions Assistant to join our world-class team. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, love the idea of being the operational backbone of a company’s marketing engine, and have strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, content creation, CRM systems, and social media, this role is for you.



***About us:

Polaris is a consulting agency with a bold mission: To help 1 million Founders to leverage time, reclaim freedom, and scale without sacrifice. We’re the only firm blending coaching and done-for-you services through a hybrid model — empowering our clients with strategic delegation, streamlined operations, and scalable systems.



***Role Mission

Be the driving force behind the short-form content engine of established, fast-growing **founder-led brands**. You’ll work closely with Founders and client teams to turn raw talking-head videos, b-roll, voice notes, event footage, and brand assets into high-performing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms. Your work will directly help founder-led brands grow visibility, attract leads, increase audience engagement, and position themselves as trusted leaders in their industries through sharp, brand-aligned, platform-native content.





***Role Responsibilities

Short-Form Video Editing & Content Packaging

- Transform raw talking-head and b-roll footage into engaging short-form videos with strong hooks, tight pacing, clean cuts, captions, and visual emphasis.

- Edit platform-native videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other short-form content channels.

- Create multiple short-form formats, including talking-head reels, b-roll remixes, caption-overlay reels, educational videos, founder-brand reels, and promotional clips.

- Apply strong editing judgment around rhythm, music, transitions, pattern interrupts, zooms, framing, captions, and retention-focused pacing.

- QA all videos before submission or publication to ensure clean captions, strong audio, correct formatting, brand alignment, and high-quality exports.



Graphic Design & Carousel Content

- Design branded graphics, carousel posts, quote cards, reel covers, and promotional visuals aligned with each client’s brand guidelines.

- Turn key ideas, frameworks, quotes, and educational concepts into simple, visually strong carousel content.

- Create clean caption-overlay graphics and visual assets that support short-form video and social media campaigns.

- Maintain consistency across typography, colors, layout, spacing, visual hierarchy, and overall brand style.

- Ensure every graphic or carousel feels polished, platform-native, and aligned with the founder-led brand’s voice and positioning.



Content Creation & Management

- Use AI to research trends, winning content references, viral short-form formats, competitor content, and creative angles.

- Review raw content assets to identify strong hooks, clips, moments, b-roll sequences, and short-form content opportunities.

- Plan and maintain a content calendar to ensure consistent, on-time publishing across social platforms.

- Organize content assets, including raw footage, b-roll, edited videos, brand photos, graphics, captions, references, and creative briefs.

- Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity to generate first-draft hooks, captions, content angles, and short-form video ideas.



Social Media Engagement & Audience Management

-- Monitor, respond to, and engage with comments, messages, and mentions across social platforms.

- Help maintain an active, consistent, and professional brand presence for founder-led brands.

- Support audience growth by identifying relevant online communities, ICP profiles, warm connections, and engagement opportunities.

- Set up and manage simple ManyChat automations for new followers, CTA opt-ins, and follow-up flows.

- Track engagement patterns and audience feedback to identify what content is resonating and where improvements can be made.

title: 🎬 Creative Video Editor | Viral Lifestyle Content | The Morning Hero
description:
# 🎬 Creative Video Editor | Viral Lifestyle Content | The Morning Hero



**Help us inspire the world to live a Five-Star Life! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐**



We're looking for a highly creative, talented video editor to join **The Morning Hero**, a growing personal development and lifestyle movement on a mission to inspire people to wake up to their full potential and live a Five-Star Life.



**This isn't your typical video editing job.**



We're not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together, adds captions, and calls it a day.



We're looking for a **creative storyteller** who can turn ordinary, everyday moments into extraordinary, inspiring, scroll-stopping content that people want to watch, share, and experience for themselves.



### 🌟 The Mission



At The Morning Hero, we believe a Five-Star Life is built one Five-Star Day at a time.



Our philosophy is centered around five daily habits we call the HEROS:



⭐ **Heart Rate:** Move your body and get stronger.



⭐ **Eat Right:** Fuel your body and your mind.



⭐ **Read:** Learn, grow, and become better.



⭐ **One Big Action:** Make meaningful progress toward your biggest goals.



⭐ **Spread Joy:** Create happiness and meaningful connections with others.



We want to show the world what this lifestyle looks like in real life.



Not through lectures. Not through advertisements.



**Through stories that inspire people to say, "I WANT THAT LIFE!"**



### 🎥 What You'll Be Doing



I'll be documenting my daily lifestyle and uploading raw video footage into organized, shared folders.



This footage will include:



- Early morning routines and workouts

- Healthy meals and nutrition

- Reading, learning, and personal growth

- Building a business and pursuing big goals

- Spending quality time with my wife and kids

- Adventures, fun, and meaningful life experiences

- Behind-the-scenes moments of living a Five-Star Life



**Your job is to turn this footage into compelling, viral-style short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.**



You'll have the creative freedom to:



- Find powerful stories hidden within everyday footage

- Develop attention-grabbing hooks that stop the scroll

- Combine multiple clips into engaging lifestyle montages and mini-stories

- Use music, sound design, transitions, text, and effects to create emotion

- Identify viral editing styles and creatively adapt them to our brand

- Experiment with new concepts, formats, and storytelling techniques

- Subtly integrate The Morning Hero app into the content when appropriate



The goal isn't simply to get views.



**The goal is to make people WANT to live a Five-Star Life and inspire them to download The Morning Hero app to start their own journey.**



### 🚀 Who We're Looking For



You might be a great fit if you:



- LOVE creating short-form, viral-style content.

- Understand what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.

- Have a strong sense of storytelling, pacing, emotion, and music.

- Know how to transform raw lifestyle footage into compelling narratives.

- Follow trends on TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

- Can take creative ownership without needing step-by-step instructions.

- Are comfortable working independently from shared footage folders.

- Have experience editing cinematic lifestyle, fitness, motivational, or personal-brand content.

- Can balance beautiful visuals with engaging, high-retention storytelling.

- Are excited about health, personal growth, entrepreneurship, and living life to the fullest.



**Most importantly, we want someone who brings IDEAS, not just editing skills.**



We want you to watch the footage and say, "I have an amazing idea for a video!"







### ❤️ Why Join The Morning Hero?



We're building something bigger than a social media account.



We're building a movement.



The Morning Hero app helps people develop five powerful daily habits that lead to greater health, happiness, productivity, financial growth, and fulfillment.



Your work will help introduce thousands of people to a lifestyle that could genuinely change their lives.



You'll have creative freedom, ongoing content to work with, and the opportunity to grow with a mission-driven brand.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term creative partner, not just complete a few editing projects.



### 📩 How to Apply



1. Record a video of yourself answering the question "Why do you want to work for Morning Hero?"

2. Send your video submission to 



We may invite shortlisted candidates to complete a short, paid creative editing test using footage from The Morning Hero.



**If you love storytelling, creativity, and inspiring people to become the best version of themselves, we'd love to hear from you.**



Let's inspire the world to wake up and WIN EVERY DAMN DAY! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

title: Service Dispatcher – Field Service / Technician Scheduling
description:
AAA Forklifts, Parts & Service is looking for an experienced Service Dispatcher to coordinate our field service technicians and help keep our daily service schedule running smoothly.



Dispatch experience is strongly preferred for this position. We are looking for someone who has experience scheduling and coordinating technicians, drivers, contractors, delivery personnel, or other field/mobile employees—not simply general customer service experience.



What You'll Do

As our Service Dispatcher, you'll be at the center of our daily service operations.

You'll receive service calls from customers, gather the necessary equipment and repair information, and coordinate those requests with our field technicians.



Throughout the day, you'll:

- Schedule and dispatch field service technicians

- Assign service calls based on technician availability, location, and workload

- Coordinate routes to reduce unnecessary travel and improve efficiency

- Handle schedule changes, urgent service calls, cancellations, and delays

- Communicate with customers regarding technician arrival times and service updates

- Gather accurate equipment information and details about the customer's service issue

- Verify service requests, warranties, parts requirements, and other job information

- Keep technicians updated throughout the day

- Follow up with customers after service

- Maintain accurate service notes, records, and communications in our service software

- Coordinate with our Service Advisors, Parts Department, and Service Manager



This is a fast-moving position. Priorities can change throughout the day, so we're looking for someone who can stay organized, communicate clearly, and make good decisions without losing track of the details.



What We're Looking For

Strong candidates will have previous dispatching experience, particularly coordinating field employees or mobile service teams.



Experience may include:

- Automotive or equipment service dispatch

- HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or appliance service dispatch

- Roadside assistance or towing dispatch

- Trucking, transportation, or delivery dispatch

- Construction or contractor scheduling

- Field service technician coordination

- Fleet or logistics dispatch



Forklift experience is not required. We can teach you our equipment and processes. What we're looking for is someone who already understands the pace and responsibility of dispatching.



Requirements

- Previous dispatching, field service coordination, or technician scheduling experience strongly preferred

- Strong spoken and written English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone throughout the workday

- Excellent organization and multitasking skills

- Able to manage multiple technicians and service calls simultaneously

- Comfortable making schedule adjustments when priorities change

- Strong computer and typing skills

- Detail-oriented with accurate documentation

- Able to work independently while communicating closely with the service team



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience working with a U.S.-based company

- Automotive, forklift, heavy equipment, or industrial service experience

- Experience using dispatch, CRM, ERP, or field-service management software

- Bilingual English/Spanish



About AAA Forklifts

At AAA Forklifts, Parts & Service, we help customers with equipment repair, maintenance, parts, buying, selling, and trading.

We're a growing team that values communication, accountability, teamwork, and people who take ownership of their work. You'll work closely with our service and parts teams and play an important role in making sure our customers receive fast, organized, and reliable service.



How to Apply



Put SERVICE FIRST in the subject line and answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your dispatching experience.

What type of technicians, drivers, contractors, or field employees did you dispatch, and approximately how many did you coordinate at one time?



2. Walk us through how you managed a typical dispatch schedule.

How did you assign jobs and keep track of technician locations, availability, travel time, and changes throughout the day?



3. Give us an example of a difficult dispatch situation you handled.

For example: an emergency service call came in, a technician was running late, a job took longer than expected, or a customer needed immediate service. What did you do?



4. Have you worked for a U.S.-based company?

If yes, tell us about the company, your position, and your main responsibilities.



5. This position involves answering incoming service calls and speaking with American customers throughout the day.

Rate your phone communication skills from 1–10 and briefly explain your rating.



6. What dispatching, scheduling, CRM, or field-service software have you used?



7. Voice Recording



Using Vocaroo, send us a 60–90 second recording introducing yourself and answering:

“Tell us about your dispatch experience and why you would be good at coordinating field service technicians and communicating with customers.”



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Remote Inbound Sales Representative
description:
Please Read the Whole Job Description Before Applying.



Build your sales career at a growing startup on a mission to transform end-of-life care.



You know how to build trust, handle objections, and close. At Meadow, you’ll put those strengths to work helping families choose cremation services with confidence.



We’re expanding across the U.S. and building the sales team that takes us further. We hire people for their strengths, treat them well, and they stay. Expect paid training, honest feedback, clear targets, and room to grow.





The role

As an Inbound Sales Representative, you’ll listen with empathy and guide families who have reached out to Meadow through their options with clarity and compassion. You’ll own individual sales targets, offer thoughtful recommendations, and follow through to close - helping families make confident decisions without pressure. There’s no cold calling.



Depending on team needs and performance, your work may include inbound calls, returning lead follow-up, and support that keeps the sales process running smoothly.



The conversations can be sensitive, but our teammates often describe the work as deeply rewarding. You’ll bring clarity to an unfamiliar process and help families take an important next step.





Day to day, you’ll:



- Convert warm inbound phone leads through thoughtful, consultative conversations.

- Explain cremation options and pricing, handle objections, and confidently ask for the sale.

- Follow up by phone, text, and
, keeping records and next steps accurate.

- Meet sales and quality targets while supporting queue coverage and related workflows.



Who this is for

- Experienced sellers. You bring 2+ years of sales experience and a record of hitting individual targets, ideally closing consumer sales over the phone.

- Strong communicators. Your spoken and written English is clear, warm, and confident.

- People who take ownership. You track your numbers, follow through, and act when you’re behind.

- Steady, coachable teammates. You stay composed, use feedback, and adapt as a growing startup evolves.

- You’re comfortable with HubSpot or a similar CRM and have a workspace that meets our technical requirements.



Extra points for Spanish fluency or experience in high-trust categories such as insurance, healthcare, or travel.



How you’ll grow

Most teammates start as Second Call Representatives, building product knowledge, closing sales, and developing Meadow’s consultative approach.



High-performing Day Shift reps may become eligible for the First Call Representative team after approximately three months. First Call reps receive more inbound opportunities and move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan tied directly to dollars sold.



Advancement depends on sustained results, including conversion performance, customer experience, workflow accuracy, and reliability. It isn’t automatic, but the path is clear.





Why You’ll Love Working With Us:

- We’re a real business, built to last. We’ve proven our model in LA and became the largest independent funeral home in California in less than two years.  We’re now going national. And plan to grow for years to come.

- A serious employer for global teammates. We have years of experience running distributed teams. Same 1:1s, check-ins, and career paths as our U.S. team - same expectations, same opportunities.

- People stay. Regrettable turnover is very low. Don't take our word for it - read our Glassdoor reviews.

- Fair compensation with real upside. Competitive globally benchmarked base pay, meaningful monthly bonuses, and a clear path to an uncapped compensation plan through eligibility to our First Call team.

- High care, high standards. Real investment in training and growth, honest feedback, no burnout culture.

- Benefits: PTO, 10 paid holidays, paid training, fully remote.

- Purpose-driven work: Real impact during one of life's most meaningful transitions.



Details:

- Remote, full-time

- Compensation: $6-$9 OTE, including base pay and monthly performance bonuses.

- Additional upside: Eligible First Call Representatives move to an uncapped performance-based compensation plan.

- Schedule: Full-time, eight-hour shifts on a fixed weekly schedule.

- Days: Monday–Friday, Tuesday–Saturday



Shift starts:

- AM: Start between 6 am-10 am ET

- PM: Start between 11 am-2 pm ET

Availability: Being open to any of these schedules is a plus. Once assigned, your schedule stays fixed.

- Tools: HubSpot, Aircall, Google Workspace, Slack, and our case management system.



About Meadow



At Meadow, we’re reimagining end-of-life care - a $23B industry untouched by modern software or service thinking. In under a year, we became the largest cremation provider in Los Angeles, with 90+ NPS and hundreds of families served monthly. Now we’re scaling across the U.S. and hiring globally.



We believe great people live everywhere. Our team works across continents and time zones, grounded by shared values: high standards, deep empathy, and a drive to do work that matters.



Learn more about our global team and apply today.

Briefly explain how you would validate Google Ads location and conversion settings as well. Stop before any live publication or spend. No access to our client accounts is needed for this screening video.
